name: PricingPageContent
description: Pricing page content assembly with packages, agency comparison, and deliverables.
dense: Full /pricing route body: package tiers, agency comparison table, and deliverables; CTAs prefill contact booking via packageId.

usage.description: PricingPageContent assembles the whole pricing page: package tiers, the agency comparison table (semantic table markup), and deliverables. Package CTAs deep-link to /contact with packageId query params that prefill the booking tab. Mount once per /pricing route; for a single inline pricing card elsewhere, compose atoms instead.

bestPractices.description: Let package CTAs carry packageId query params; ContactInquiryPanel picks them up to preselect the booking package.
Don't embed it for a single homepage pricing card; compose Card/Text/Button directly.

ariaRequirements: CTA links route to contact with package prefill
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-06-06 — package cards, comparison table, and ForcedColors story verified in Storybook.
a11y.playFunctionExempt: Page assembly; interactive CTAs inherit Button and Link primitives.

forbiddenUse: embed single package card without page context
promote to stable without visual baseline on stable fleet
